nodes.name: Fluoride-mediated CoSe2 pre-catalyst synthesis
nodes.procedure: Fluoride-substituted CoSe₂ nanobelts with reinforced bonding (denoted as F-CoSe₂-r) were synthesized as pre-catalysts, verified by well-maintained belt-like morphology, lattice spacing of 2.6Å corresponding to (210) planes, Co-Se coordination at 2.03Å, and Co-F coordination at 1.64Å with reduced Co-Se coordination number from 4.0 to 2.8.
nodes.source_text: fluoride-substituted CoSe₂ nanobelts with reinforced bonding (denoted as F-CoSe₂-r) were synthesized as pre-catalysts... verified as well-maintained belt-like morphology by TEM

nodes.name: OER reconstruction without fluoride
nodes.procedure: Under OER conditions, pure selenide pre-catalysts CoSe₂ were attacked by OH⁻ ions from electrolytes with leaching of lattice Se and partial Co ions, leading to reconstructed amorphous CoOOH-c with completely long-range disorder.

unit_operations.name: OH⁻ attack and leaching
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: attacked by OH⁻ ions from electrolytes, together with the leaching of lattice Se and partial Co ions

nodes.source_text: Under OER conditions, the pure selenide pre-catalysts tended to be attacked by OH⁻ ions from electrolytes... leading to the reconstructed amorphous CoOOH with completely long-range disorder (denoted as CoOOH-c)

nodes.name: Fluoride-mediated OER reconstruction to CoOOH-l
nodes.procedure: 6% F-CoSe₂-r pre-catalysts under OER conditions underwent reconstruction where strengthened Co-F bonding stabilized lattice Co, localizing long-range disorder to form amorphous CoOOH-l nanosheets. Fluorine ions leached out and Se was completely removed during process.

unit_operations.name: Co stabilization
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: strengthened Co-F bonding than Co-Se bonding... could stabilize lattice Co during reconstruction

unit_operations.name: F and Se leaching
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: incorporated fluorine ions could further leach out under OER conditions... complete Se leaching

nodes.source_text: With fluoride substitution, the strengthened Co-F bonding... localizing the long-range disorder of reconstructed amorphous CoOOH (denoted as CoOOH-l)

nodes.name: OER reconstruction to CoOOH-s
nodes.procedure: Reconstructed CoOOH nanosheets with slightly localized long-range disorder were prepared (denoted as CoOOH-s) by similar reconstruction from 2% F-CoSe₂-r pre-catalysts with reduced fluorine content.
nodes.source_text: reconstructed CoOOH nanosheets with slightly localized long-range disorder were prepared (denoted as CoOOH-s) by similar reconstruction from 2% F-CoSe₂-r pre-catalysts

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows lattice spacing of 2.6 Å corresponding to (210) planes of cubic CoSe2 phase for F-CoSe2-r.
nodes.evidence_snippet: with a lattice spacing of 2.6 Å corresponding to (210) planes of the cubic CoSe2 phase by high-resolution TEM (Figures 1b and S1)

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns verify cubic CoSe2 phase for pre-catalysts.
EXAFS shows Co-Se contribution at 2.03 Å and Co-F at 1.64 Å for F-CoSe2-r with reduced Co-Se coordination number from 4.0 to 2.8.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) spectra in Figure 1c demonstrated the selenide structures of pre-catalysts with a prominent peak of Co-Se contribution at 2.03 Å ... as well as the reduced Co-Se coordination number from 4.0 for CoSe2 to 2.8 for F-CoSe2-r

nodes.characterization_summary: Co K-edge XANES shows increased white line intensity for F-CoSe2-r implying reinforced Co-F bonding.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In Co K-edge X-ray absorption near-edge spectroscopy (XANES), Figure S4a, an increased intensity of the white line from CoSe2 to F-CoSe2-r was clearly observed

nodes.characterization_summary: Co 2p XPS shows positive shift with fluoride incorporation in pre-catalysts; F 1s XPS confirms 6 mol% F and vanished F-Co bond at 684.2 eV after reconstruction; Se 3d XPS shows complete Se leaching after reconstruction.
nodes.evidence_snippet: This result was further verified by the positive shift of Co 2p XPS peaks with fluoride incorporation (Figure S4b). The mole percentage of fluorine ions was determined as 6% by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) ... vanished F-Co bond peak at 684.2 eV after reconstruction in F 1s XPS spectra (Figure S6). Meanwhile, complete Se leaching could also be verified by the vanished Se 3d XPS signals after reconstruction (Figure S7)

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman shows FWHM shrinkage of Co-O peaks at 497 and 590 cm⁻¹ for CoOOH-l indicating decreased long-range disorder.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Such a process was identified by in situ Raman with varied potential cycles under OER conditions (Figure 1d) ... Notably, with fluoride mediation, the FWHM of these two peaks exhibited a shrinkage (Figure S5), indicating the decreased long-range disorder for CoOOH-l relative to CoOOH-c

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-OES shows decreased Co leaching during fluoride-mediated reconstruction.
nodes.evidence_snippet: as suggested by inductively coupled plasma-optical emission spectrometry (ICP-OES), Figure 1e, the obviously decreased Co leaching into electrolytes with applied potential cycles

nodes.evidence_snippet: For CoOOH-l, the TEM image in Figure 1f suggested the ultrathin and sheet-like morphology

nodes.evidence_snippet: while the HRTEM image clearly presented the localized amorphous structure, together with dense crystalline domains with a lattice spacing of 2.3 Å corresponding to (012) planes of the CoOOH phase (Figure 1g)

nodes.characterization_summary: AC HAADF-STEM proves tensile strain at domain boundaries of CoOOH-l with enlarged atom distance.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the aberration-corrected high-angle annular dark-field scanning TEM (AC HAADF-STEM) image for CoOOH-l proved the existence of tensile strain at these domain boundaries, as verified by the enlarged atom distance at boundaries (Figures 1h and S9)

nodes.characterization_summary: EXAFS shows Co-O at 1.4 Å and Co-Co at 2.4 Å for all reconstructed CoOOH; coordination numbers increase from CoOOH-c to CoOOH-l approaching β-CoOOH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure 2a, all the samples exhibited two typical peaks at around 1.4 and 2.4 Å for Co-O and Co-Co bonds ... relative to CoOOH-c reconstructed without fluoride mediation, the coordination numbers of both Co-O and Co-Co bonds showed the obvious increase from CoOOH-s to CoOOH-l, approaching those for standard β-CoOOH

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD confirms all reconstructed CoOOH nanosheets maintain amorphous phase.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Meanwhile, the XRD patterns in Figure 2c verified that all the reconstructed CoOOH nanosheets with tuned long-range disorder still maintained the amorphous phase

nodes.characterization_summary: Co 2p XPS of CoOOH-l shows peaks at 780.1 and 781.3 eV for Co³⁺; O 1s shows peaks at 529.3 eV (O-Co), 530.4 eV (OH-Co), 531.1 eV (low-coordination O), 531.9 eV (adsorbed water); positive shift in Co 2p and negative shift in O 1s from CoOOH-c to CoOOH-l indicate strengthened Co-O covalency.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Co 2p XPS spectrum of CoOOH-l showed two typical peaks at 780.1 and 781.3 eV, attributable to the Co³⁺ cations ... from CoOOH-c to CoOOH-l, a positive shift of the Co 2p binding energy and negative shift of the O 1s binding energy were clearly observed

nodes.characterization_summary: Double-layer capacitance tests show ECSA for CoOOH-l is 3.3-fold and 4-fold higher than CoOOH-s and CoOOH-c respectively.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the electrochemical active surface area (ECSA) for CoOOH-l as evaluated by double-layer capacitance tests (Figure S13), only showed a 3.3-fold and 4-fold increase relative to CoOOH-s and CoOOH-c, respectively
